review_evidence: README identifies the project as a formalization of event structures and causal-consistent reversibility.
The primary modules formalize traces, replay, residuals, paths, computations, finite posets, configurations, rollback, labelled transition systems, and CCS syntax/semantics/bisimulation.
These modules are the direct mathematical and semantic content of the project; no lossless primary exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the full event-structures and causal-reversibility formalization.
